exclusions.source_text: (A) Synovial Sarcoma: 2 to 17 years (B) MPNST, Neuroblastoma and Osteosarcoma: 2 to 21 years
exclusions.threshold: age 2 to 17 years (SS); 2 to 21 years (MPNST, NB, OS)

exclusions.source_text: (A) Subjects ≥16: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) 0 or 1 (B) Subjects 2 to 16: Lansky score ≥ 80
Active infection with human immunodeficiency virus, hepatitis B virus, hepatitis C virus, or human T cell leukemia virus
Other prior malignancy that is not considered by the Investigator to be in complete remission
